Caledonian Bulk Distribution plc
Attn: Fiona Duthie, Network Planning
Gateway House, 3 Farringdon Road
London, EC1A 1BB, UK
Tel: +44 20 7946 0330

SERVICE TYPE

Groupage Consolidation
Single Company → Hub → Two Calling Points → Hub
High Volume, High Unit Count

TRUNK ROUTE

Collection Hub: London & South East
Calling at: Nottingham, then Leeds
Outbound Hub: Edinburgh (Scotland)
Trunk: London → Nottingham → Leeds
→ Edinburgh

COLLECTION

Collection from Caledonian Bulk Distribution, London EC1A 1BB, into the London consolidation centre. Delivery to EH1 1AA, Edinburgh. Three trunk hops.

TRUNK ITINERARY — A LARGE BLOCK RIDES ONLY THE MIDDLE HOP

|  PALLET LINE | PALLETS | WEIGHT / PALLET | JOINS TRUNK AT | LEAVES TRUNK AT  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  Retail display units, flat-packed | 6 | 400 kg | London (origin) | Edinburgh (destination)  |
|  Seasonal stock, shrink-wrapped — bulk block | 18 | 950 kg | Joins at Nottingham | Leaves at Leeds  |

Hop-by-hop the truck carries: London → Nottingham 6 pallets; Nottingham → Leeds 24 pallets, 19,500 kg; Leeds → Edinburgh 6 pallets. The booking totals 24 pallets, but no single hop carries the whole booking — and the middle hop is the only one anywhere near capacity.

CONSOLIDATED CARGO SUMMARY

|  ORIGIN COMPANY | MATERIAL / GOODS DESCRIPTION | L X W X D (CM) | LINE WEIGHT | QTY (UNITS) | PALLETS  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  Caledonian Bulk Distribution | Retail display units, flat-packed | 120 x 100 x 150 | 16 kg/unit | 150 | 6  |
|  Caledonian Bulk Distribution | Seasonal stock cartons, shrink-wrapped | 120 x 100 x 160 | 12 kg/carton | 1,425 | 18  |
|  **Totals** |  |  |  | **1,575** | **24**  |

Total pallets booked: 24. Total units: 1,575. Peak pallets on any one hop: 24 (Nottingham → Leeds). Collection and delivery legs each carry 6 pallets.

HANDLING NOTES

A three-hop trunk exceeds the default network hop ceiling of two. Quoted as-is, the engine refuses the route — "Too many intermediate stops (2); the limit is 1." — until the trunk-hop limit is raised to three in the groupage routing configuration. This is deliberate: the ceiling is a configured commercial limit, not a hidden one.

One end-to-end line-haul rate applies to all 24 pallets regardless of the hop each rides; two calling points each add a flat handling fee. The eighteen-pallet block boards at Nottingham on freight collected by another run and alights at Leeds, so it never touches this booking's collection or delivery vehicle.
